description: This file contains utility functions for handling user authentication flows in a web application, including sign-up, password resets, magic link login, and OAuth sign-in, using the Supabase client.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors by logging and navigating to specific error pages based on error message content.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, redirecting to a callback URL upon success.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email to the specified address, redirecting to the reset password page.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Performs sign-in using a magic link sent via email, redirecting upon success.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Initiates OAuth sign-in with a specified provider, redirecting upon success.
